snippet.title: Beastro | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
We’ve been hard at work in the kitchen cooking up some exciting news Beastro is coming to PS5, Steam and Xbox Series X|S and Game Pass.

Beastro is a crunchy cozy deckbuilder where you cook up the decks for the heroes visiting your town. Farm, gather, and fish up new ingredients to serve your patrons and send them off to battle the monsters in the wilds. Upon their return, they'll provide you their spoils: monstrous ingredients to unlock new recipes and meals!

No one can save the world on an empty stomach.

Wishlist on Steam: https://bit.ly/4pPNHWe 
Wishlist on PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017655
Wishlist on Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/beastro/9NJRSC0B0K88
